screen: THE DECK'S OWN SCREEN. The AI models box lives in the Steam main window ('Steam Big Picture Mode' page): 854 x 534 CSS px at devicePixelRatio 1.5 (screenshot 1280 x 800). The box's dialog is 660 x 420 at left 97, top 56 to 64.
summary_plain: On the Deck the D-pad Right from the left-hand filter column almost never goes to what sits next to the ring. All 12 stops in the column (and the two in the title row) were tried. Advanced and the Refresh icon do nothing on Right. Every one of the 12 column stops sends Right to the first star in the list (the gemma4 row, which is the first list stop), wherever the ring was. That row is level with the origin for only 2 of the 12 (Also try open-weight models, +3 px; Expert, -7 px). The other 10 land 32 to 100 px above or below: Clear +85, Open source only +32, Speed -76, Strategy -99, Vision -34, Installed only -86, Deck essentials only -100, Recently added -35, Type a name -68, Install the starter set -96. Worst first: Deck essentials only (-100), Strategy (-99), Starter set (-96), Installed only (-86), Clear (+85). Left from a list star goes to the 'Install the starter set' chip at the bottom of the column, not to the filter beside it: star0 +96, star1 +98, star2 +63 below the star's own line (only star3, level with that chip, is beside, +2). Up from the first star goes to the 'Text' chip of the try-order row (-85, the way back Down returns to the star). Left always comes back from the cell Right reached, but Right does not always come back to where it started: Right from the Starter set chip went to star0 once and star2 another time, depending on where the box had scrolled. Inside a list row the D-pad is fine: Right/Left move cell to cell along the same line (star, move up, move down, Remove). Down from the last column stop and from the last list row both reach 'Done' as expected. The row 'Any installed model - turn on the unlock' is drawn in the column but Down skips it: it is never a stop.

what_not_asked_but_seen: The try-order row exists twice in the page for a moment: two boxes were stacked (see side_effect). The older one showed the 'Pictures' chip active, the top one 'Text'. After both were closed and the box reopened once, one box, 'Text' active.

In the screenshot, the box's top rows (the 'Installed 2 - 4.3 GB' count line) are drawn over the 'Expert' row while the ring is far down the column: the body scrolls under the header. The Steam performance overlay at top left hides the 'AI models' title and part of the count line (overlay is Steam's, not the plugin).

close_and_reopen: B pressed once from Move down: the top box closed and the ring jumped to 'Clear' in a SECOND box that was still open under it (focus read: 'Clear the Good for and Show filters'). B again: that box closed and the ring went to the 'Browse models...' button on the Ollama tab, which means that second box had been opened from 'Browse models...', not from 'AI models'. I did not open it (the only A I pressed on the way in was on the 'AI models' button); it was already stacked under mine, or my first A opened both. Then reopened once from the 'AI models' button: one box (Modal_3), same state as at the start (Also try open-weight models ticked, Deck essentials only ticked, every other row unticked, '4 models match', 4 list rows). B closed it: ring on the 'AI models' button, no box in the page. Then closed the 'AI models' fold line (A on its line after reading focus) and walked Up to the tab bar. No tick changed, none to put back.
expected: Reading row (a map). Down from the last column stop and from the last list row: footer (Done).
verdict: PASS (recorded) - every stop in the column and the title row was tried with Right then Left; the cells of rows 0 to 3 with Left and Right; Up and Down from the four stars; Down from the last column stop and the last list row.
PASS - Down from the last column stop (Install the starter set) and from the last visible list row (star3) both went to Done, the footer, as expected.
UNCLEAR - 'a second box was already open under mine' is a surprise I cannot explain: see side_effect and the report.
side_effect: No setting, tick or model changed. A pressed three times in the box area: once on the 'AI models' fold line, once on the 'AI models' button (twice in total, the second time to reopen), each after reading focus; never on a star, a Pull, a Move or a Remove. A stray state worth knowing: two copies of the AI models box were open at once (one opened from 'Browse models...'). Both are closed now.
